fields.description: A word or phrase to look for in a statement remark, matched case-insensitively on word boundaries. The LONGEST matching keyword wins, so a more specific phrase beats a general word.
fields.label: Keyword

fields.description: Which ledger this rule applies to. The same word means different types on either side: a courier charge on a project is Material Transportation Charges, but off a project it is Postage & Courier. Most expense types exist on only ONE side, so a rule cannot be shared.
fields.label: Ledger

fields.description: The expense type to record. It MUST carry the flag matching this rule's ledger (project for Project, non_project for Non Project) or the import will refuse to write it.
fields.label: Expense Type

fields.description: Untick to retire a rule without deleting it, so the history of what a past import would have done stays readable.
fields.label: Active
